purpose: One fixed Linux process-and-journal integration validation after local mock tests and independent review, not ATPG/training
reason_separate_package_needed: E75's four SSH sessions and sole container are consumed. New journal integration also needs narrowly scoped persistent output, which E75's script-only read-only mount did not authorize.
second_session: Only bounded audit or exact-ID cleanup of this same container after uncertainty; never another creation or execution retry
read_budget_scope: Metadata-and-collected-journal cap covers host-side Docker projections and collected result/journal bodies. Existing gate kernel pseudofile reads retain their reviewed per-read limits within the fixed three-profile run, and are not presented as measured host metadata bytes.

mounts.writable: One fresh empty journal-output subdirectory under the exclusive new root, mounted as /journal; no pre-existing data or repository mount
mounts.reason: Keep write-before-launch and identity records outside ephemeral container scratch so a failed container does not silently erase the intended-attempt evidence
mounts.filesystem_limit: Fsync ACK and surviving bytes are not a proof of power-loss durability or historical ACK on replay

steps_covered_by_one_future_approval: Complete bounded launcher/collector implementation and local tests
Freeze actual source/image/options SHA and independent preexecution review
Fresh exact-ID image/resource/host checks, no image inventory/pull/build
Create one container, run success/failure/timeout_group once with durable journal
Verify real identity/cleanup/ACK sequence, export small raw journal and result hashes
On failure stop, preserve evidence, do not rerun; only own exact-ID cleanup is allowed
Independent result audit, Chinese overview, SHA seal and normal version synchronization
isolation: No network, GPU, privileged mode, added capabilities, host namespace, image healthcheck or arbitrary command/data input; readonly rootfs and no-new-privileges
forbidden: BLIND or other real labels/checkpoint bodies
